messages:
incident-bot: PAGING: p99 inference latency > 2s for /v1/generate (us-west). Affected customers: several medium tenants. Pager: @ana :rotating_light:
ana: Got it — joining. Any known change or deploy?
matt: No deploys in last 2h. I see a sustained spike in batch queue length on gpu-pool-3.
leo: Adding context — KV cache miss rate jumped ~3x at ~03:04 according to tracing. Could be model size mismatch on some replicas.
ana: Mitigating now: scaling up gpu-pool-3 by 2 nodes, routing low-priority traffic to fallback model variant.
ana: Re-routing done, scale started. Not seeing immediate latency drop yet.
ana: ops-scribe can you capture customer impact matrix? I want to know which tenants lost throughput vs increased latency.
ops-scribe: On it — pulling per-tenant p95/p99 and error counts. Will paste in a sec.
ops-scribe: quick summary: tenant-a (high traffic) p99 went 800ms -> 2.6s, tenant-b small spike, tenant-c unaffected. No 5xx increase.
rebecca: For the postmortem / retro dashboard, we should add panels: per-tenant p99 heatmap, pool queue depth, kv-cache hit ratio, model-variant routing %. Drilldowns to traces for selected time window.
matt: I can push a temporary alert adjustment: raise the p99 alert threshold for fallback model from 1.2s -> 1.8s to reduce noise while we stabilize. We should document change and revert in the retro.
leo: Sharing a quick PromQL we used in alert so we can clone for the new panel:
```
max_over_time((histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route=\"/v1/generate\"}[5m])) by (le, tenant))) [1h:5m])
```
rebecca: For the dashboard JSON — suggest panels laid out: 1) Golden signals overview (latency/p50/p95/p99, errors, throughput), 2) Pool-level drilldowns, 3) Per-tenant leaderboard, 4) Trace links panel. I'll draft panels and share a PR to infra-dashboards.
nana: Current status: latency trending down after scale + routing. If stable for 10m, I'll handoff to next oncall with runbook notes.
ops-scribe: Noted. I'll attach a CSV of tenant p99 snapshots and the short customer-impact blurb for SRE notes.
matt: Created temporary alert change: #infra-alerts: change p99 generate -> 1.8s, expiration set 4h. Please review in PR.
rebecca: Created dashboard draft branch: refs/heads/retro-generate-2026-03-17 — includes heatmap and trace drilldown links. Request review from @matt and @ana.
nana: Thanks team. Handoff in 12m to @leo — I'll post final status and checklist in this thread before I sign off. :white_check_mark:
leo: Ready to take over. If things regress, I will rollback routing and scale further.
ops-scribe: final note: no customer-facing 5xx, mitigation prevented broader impact. Will capture alerts changed and dashboard PR in the incident ticket.
incident-bot: Incident resolved (mitigation stable). Closing page in 20m if no new paging events.
